# Lisbon Trip

Five days in June, staying in a flat in Alfama up a lot of stairs.

## Highlights

- Tram 28 early in the morning before the queues.
- Custard tarts at Manteigaria, still warm. Better than the famous place in Belem.
- Sunset from the Miradouro da Senhora do Monte.

## Next time

Go in May, June was already hot by 11 am. Book the Sintra train tickets the day before, the machines at Rossio had a long line.
